video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns Still Can’t Believe He’s an NBA Champion, Talks Teammates Attending His Wedding

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the surreal feeling of being an NBA champion
quotes.excerpt: the player in me is super excited to be part of this moment.

text_blocks.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
text_blocks.text: Are you used to hearing NBA champion connected to your name?

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: It is special. The Knicks fan in me cannot believe I am still hearing that the Knicks won a championship, but the player in me is super excited to be part of this moment. I knew I would get here one day.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his early career selling sports cards
quotes.excerpt: my first card I will never forget actually got me beats by Dr. Dre headphones.

text_blocks.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
text_blocks.text: Was it collecting cards or dealing or selling them?

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: Selling cards, getting a shop ready of Spencer sports cards. I had become proficient at this new thing at the time. It was called eBay. It was a childhood passion I had. It was my first job before I got this gig as an NBA player. My first card I will never forget actually got me beats by Dr. Dre headphones. So shout out to Tim Lincecum. I actually pulled one of a Tim Lincecum card during a Cy Young year.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jaylen Brown's singing at his wedding
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown did not want to be seen. It is crazy you win a championship with a guy.

text_blocks.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
text_blocks.text: Last time you were here the whole team came and Mike Brown was here, your coach, and he started singing Who Let the Dogs Out. And I know this is you and Jaylen's reaction.

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: Jaylen Brown did not want to be seen. It is crazy you win a championship with a guy, you do not want to be seen with the guy.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's mindset for the new season
quotes.excerpt: this season is about us just going out there and starting again at 0-0.

text_blocks.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
text_blocks.text: Tell me about the mindset coming into this season.

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: Is it a cliche if I say it is 0-0 again? I was kind of the same thing we said every playoff game and when we won and we kept winning, it was great. But this season is about us just going out there and starting again at 0-0. Being that same hungry team, that team that is hungry to prove everyone wrong.
